name: Onlook
official_status_notes: Open-source (Apache-2.0) AI-first visual editor for React (Next.js + Tailwind): edit designs directly on your real codebase; hosted product in early access; MCP support and OpenRouter-based model access in the open-source stack (verified Sep 2026).
pricing_summary: Open source, free to self-host; hosted product pricing not yet verified.
best_for: Design-minded developers who want to edit a real React codebase visually with AI.
strengths: Open source; code-native (reads/writes real Next.js/Tailwind); MCP; checkpoints.
weaknesses: Focused on Next.js + Tailwind today; hosted product still in early access.
hardware_requirements: Desktop app + local preview container; modest projects fit 8 GB.
